messages.subject: A quick question, [First Name]
messages.text:
Hi [First Name],

Mike here with Stay Fresh Pools. We appreciate the opportunity to earn your business, even if we didn’t get to work together this time.

Would you be open to sharing what influenced your decision? Whether it was budget, timing, scope, or something we could have explained better, we’d appreciate your honest feedback.

We’re always challenging ourselves to raise the standard, and your perspective helps us do that. Just hit reply—a quick response goes a long way.

Thank you for your time,

messages.subject: How’s everything going with your pool, [First Name]?
messages.text:
Hi [First Name],

Mike with Stay Fresh Pools! It’s been a little while, and I wanted to check in. How’s everything going with your pool? Did you get the help you needed?

If you’re still exploring options or things haven’t gone as planned, we’d love to reconnect.

From weekly maintenance and repairs to remodels and new builds, our focus stays the same: quality, clear communication, and long-term performance.

For our weekly service customers, that means consistent water testing and balancing, equipment inspections, service reports, and respect for your property every visit. That’s the Stay Fresh standard.

Reply and let us know how things are going. Whether you need help now or down the road, we’re here.

Mike
Stay Fresh Pools
[Business Phone]

Where quality and longevity meet.

messages.subject: Welcome to the Stay Fresh Family, [First Name]!
messages.text:
Hi [First Name],

Welcome to the Stay Fresh Family! We’re excited to care for your pool, and we appreciate your trust in our team.

You can expect more than a clean pool. The Stay Fresh standard means proactive care with quality, longevity, and your swimming experience in mind.

Here’s what that looks like:

• Consistent, dependable weekly service
• Water testing and chemical balancing
• Brushing, skimming, and routine cleaning
• Equipment inspections to catch concerns early
• Service reports so you know what was done
• Clear communication about recommendations and next steps

Our team will be in touch shortly to confirm your first service date and any access details. Have questions before then? We’re just a call, text, or email away.

[Business Phone]
[Business Email]

Thank you for choosing Stay Fresh. Let’s keep your pool fresh all year round!

Mike
Stay Fresh Pools
Where quality and longevity meet.

messages.subject: Let’s get your pool Stay Fresh again, [First Name]!
messages.text:
Hi [First Name],

Mike here with Stay Fresh Pools! It’s been a while, and we’d love the opportunity to welcome you back to the Stay Fresh Family.

Our focus is simple: dependable service, proactive care, and helping your pool and equipment perform for the long run.

To welcome you back, we’re offering a complimentary pool inspection on your first visit back. We’ll check your water chemistry, surface condition, and equipment to identify potential issues early, help protect your investment, and give you a clear plan for keeping your pool in top shape.

This complimentary inspection is available for a limited time, so don’t wait until a small issue becomes a costly repair. Reply “STAY FRESH” today or call [Business Phone] to reserve your inspection and coordinate your return.

Mike
Stay Fresh Pools
Where quality and longevity meet.

messages.subject: Is your pool getting the care it deserves, [First Name]?
messages.text:
Hi [First Name],

How’s your pool been? If you’re ready for a change, we’d love to earn your business back.

The Stay Fresh standard means showing up consistently, paying attention to the details, and keeping you informed. With our weekly service, you can expect:

• Consistent water testing and chemical balancing
• Thorough cleaning and routine equipment inspections
• Service reports with chemical readings and updates
• Clear communication when something needs attention
• Respect for your pool, yard, and property

Your complimentary pool inspection is available on your first visit back.

Reply with a good time for a quick call, or reach us at [Business Phone]. Let’s talk through what your pool needs and get you back on route!

Mike
Stay Fresh Pools
